answer.says: Shri Hegde, the mist is thick this morning; the city seems to be holding its breath. I trust the second bedroom is to your liking. I shall take my walk at the usual hour, so you may rest in peace.
answer.thought: He is here, occupying the space I was meant to occupy in the file, a living contradiction that breathes. I must be courteous, for the state is the actuality of the ethical idea, and this confusion is merely a glitch in the mechanism, not a flaw in the system. I will not let the morning's haze cloud my composure.
